channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Several students killed in blast beside Afghan school
item.description: At least six students have been killed and 97 injured in an explosion beside a middle school in Asadabad, Afghanistan.

item.title: Kenyan starvation cult leader found guilty over deaths of 123 followers
item.description: Paul Mackenzie was convicted of manslaughter over the deaths of 123 followers.

item.title: Yemen government forces hit Houthi positions as UN warns of hunger crisis
item.description: About 1.8 million people face emergency levels of hunger in government-held areas, according to the UN.

item.title: At least 10 students killed in blast beside school in Afghanistan’s Kunar
item.description: The explosion occurred in an adjacent house storing dynamite for mining due to negligence, the Interior Ministry says.

item.title: El Nino-linked deluges flood cities in Peru, Ecuador
item.description: Heavy rains affect 2,000 families in Peru's Piura and 47,000 people in Ecuador, where 34 deaths have been reported.

item.title: Argentina's bid to stop Falklands oil drilling rejected
item.description: A joint venture between UK-Israeli companies is set to start exploring for oil and gas, but Argentina sought to block it as part of its claim to sovereignty.

item.title: Two staff killed in Israeli strike on Gaza medical clinic, MSF says
item.description: The Israeli military says it targeted "Hamas terrorists" in the strike which has been condemned by the World Health Organization.

item.title: Eight killed in Peruvian military helicopter crash
item.description: The pilot was the sole survivor of the crash during a rescue mission in a remote area known for drug trafficking.

item.title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader convicted over further 123 deaths
item.description: Paul Mackenzie is found guilty of killing his followers, weeks after being jailed for the mass murder of children.
